svg.aria-label: Experience: Full-Stack Engineer at LeanoSol (2026–now); Working Student IT Support & SysAdmin at Refair IT (2024); Software Engineer at Discretelogix (2023–24); Data Science Intern at IPRI (2022); Full-Stack Web Developer Intern at Innovative Solutions & Development (2021). Education: MSc Data Science, FAU (in progress); BS Computer Science. Languages: English fluent, German A2.
